svg.aria-label: AI engineering — Claude, past autocomplete. How a feature actually gets built: I own the scope and the merge, the agents do the legwork in between. I scope and decide; Claude Code plans and orchestrates parallel subagents: explore (maps the codebase); build (test first, small slices); review (fresh context, fresh eyes); only what I understand reaches main. Context it starts with: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Skills, MCP servers, Memory, Context engineering. Guardrails I keep: Evals vs hand-written truth, Schema-validated output, Model reads, code decides, I review every merge.
